_doc: Site-wide settings that outlive a campaign. gtmId: the Google Tag Manager container id (GTM-XXXXXXX); empty means no tag is written and nothing is measured through GTM. services_ar / services_en: the measurement and advertising services the container loads, named in the privacy paragraph; keep them true whenever a tag is added or removed in GTM. whatsappChannel: the Sayda WhatsApp channel's own address (https://whatsapp.com/channel/<code>); set, both pages carry the closable strip above the products, the follow links and the channel link at the end of the share message; empty, none of them appears (BLD-18). pagePolicy: "on" (default when missing) writes the Content-Security-Policy meta tag on both pages (BLD-8); "off" builds both pages without it, for when a policy breaks the page; every build says which (BLD-44). It does not touch the response headers in sayda-deals/_headers.
